categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: src/script/sign.cpp governs transaction and PSBT signing logic used by wallet signing routines (such as walletprocesspsbt).
categories.rationale: Prevents signing SIGHASH_SINGLE inputs without matching outputs in PSBT workflows, addressing a fund-safety issue where outputs could be altered without invalidating the signature. When an output at that position does not exist, the signature commits to no outputs at all, creating 'a footgun that lets funds be redirected without the owner's consent.'
